The study uses computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and the Taguchi optimization technique to analyze the structural and thermal performance of a gas turbine vane.
The three airfoil profiles studied are RAE 2822, SG 6043, and NACA 8312, with a chord length of 300 mm and a 70-degree twist angle.
The airfoils are tested with an inlet velocity of 8 m/s and an inlet temperature of 60°C, at angle of attack (AOA) ranging from 0° to 15° in 2.5° increments.
The RAE 2822 airfoil has the best lift-to-drag ratio at 0° AOA among the three profiles studied.
The RAE 2822 airfoil is tested with coolant flow rates of 0.01, 0.02, and 0.03 kg/s, and inlet gas temperatures of 60°C, 120°C, and 180°C.
The Taguchi optimization identifies the optimal combination as a coolant flow rate of 0.03 kg/s and an inlet gas temperature of 60°C.
The RAE 2822 airfoil is subjected to a centrifugal force of 5100 RPM, resulting in a maximum stress of 3.996 x 10^8 N/m^2 and a maximum strain of 4.015 x 10^-3.
The vane material used in the study is ZAMAK, and it is coated with a 0.1 mm layer of zirconia.
The study aims to optimize the design of a gas turbine vane to improve its structural and thermal performance.
The use of CFD and Taguchi optimization techniques allows the researchers to evaluate the performance of the vane without the need for extensive experimental testing.
The study provides insights into the impact of impingement cooling flow on the temperature distribution of the gas turbine vane.
The results of the study can be used to inform the design and development of more efficient and reliable gas turbine systems.
The paper highlights the importance of considering both structural and thermal factors in the design of gas turbine components.
The study demonstrates the potential of computational techniques, such as CFD and optimization methods, to enhance the design and performance of gas turbine systems.
The use of advanced materials and coatings, such as ZAMAK and zirconia, can contribute to the improved thermal and structural characteristics of gas turbine components.
